The country famous for the Great Barrier Reef is Australia.

The outlined treatment plan for acute bacterial sinusitis is appropriate. The use of amoxicillin-clavulanate for 10 days is a standard first-line antibiotic therapy for this condition. Nasal saline irrigation helps clear mucus and reduce inflammation, while oral decongestants provide symptomatic relief. The advice to return if symptoms persist beyond seven days or worsen is consistent with clinical guidelines, which recommend reassessment to ensure the infection is resolving or to consider alternative diagnoses if there is no improvement.
